zh.title: 保留最佳尝试之后，科研智能体到底完成了什么？
zh.summary: 一个最高分仍低于门槛的合成例子，说明产出保留、评分通过与科研过程恢复需要分别举证。

en.title: What has a scientific agent completed when its best attempt is retained?
en.summary: A synthetic best score below the acceptance threshold separates result retention, gate attainment and scientific-process recovery.
